TermRule
PoolAttribute + Skill (+ at most 2 bonus dice, plus any Silk dice)
SuccessEach die showing 5 or 6
Difficulty1 Trivial · 2 Easy · 3 Moderate · 4 Hard · 5 Absurd
PartialAt least half the target (round up) but short of it: succeed with a complication
FailureFewer than half the target: fail (a Partial never is), a consequence occurs
Pass/fail checkA Partial passes, no extra cost. An NPC's check needs the full Difficulty
CriticalDouble the required Successes: succeed + bonus + Alert −1 (final Difficulty 3+ only)
BotchPool at 0 or below: roll 1 die. 1–3 fail + Alert +2. 4–6 clean fail.
AssistAdjacent ally rolls a Skill that plausibly helps, no Attribute (min 1, max 3 dice, plus its own Silk dice). Each Success = +1 die.
OpposedThe creature's Successes + 1 = your Difficulty (it never Partials; once per group check). Humans: their Ch 15 Difficulty
Group checkEveryone rolls; the Alert takes the worst result, once. Counts as both of a heist obstacle's rolls
EngagedAlready active and able to reach you this round, or you're fighting it. A human's reach is its room

RuleDetail
Scale1 square = 1 spider. Distances are counted in squares.
SpeedSquares per turn, set by species. Most 5 · Wolf 7 · Jumping 6 · Crab 4.
Your turnMove up to Speed (may split) + one Action (sneaking, or a squeeze or climb roll, is one; reactions aren't). Diagonals count as 1.
AdjacencyThe 8 surrounding squares. Brawl and Assist need adjacency.
CoverA solid object between you and a viewer: your Stealth Difficulty −2; +2 Difficulty to target you. Glass blocks silk, not sight.
ClimbingNormal cost on walls/ceilings. Slick/hostile surfaces cost double or a roll. Squeezes roll only under pressure; a Silk Line is −1 Difficulty then (no roll otherwise).
HeightsIn squares: chair 2, counter 3, shelf 6, ceiling 8. A real fall: a hit of 1 die per 2 squares, rounded up.
Hurt/CriticalHurt: Speed halved (round down) · Critical: moves only with a crewmate's help, at half their Speed.
Turn orderOnly when timing is tight: crew acts (any order), then the ST's threats.

RuleDetail
Only goes up+1 failed roll w/ consequence, a Partial's complication, spotted briefly, Silk Clutch · +2 Botch, confirmed alert, spider Out, Loud Failure · +X each round a creature is active (its stat block) · one event = one trigger, the largest
Thresholds3–4 Stirring: Stealth +1 · 5–6 Active: threat wakes, Stealth +1 continues · 7+ Lockdown: all rolls +1 (Stealth +2, stacks) · Limit: Full Alert (a failed Escape roll = caught)
ReductionCritical Success only (Difficulty 3+): Alert −1, never below 0; what woke up stays awake
The clockThird round at one obstacle: roll a Mid-Heist Complication (Ch 20)
Full AlertPermanent; Lockdown penalties; the Alert stops at the Limit; a Partial costs a hit or −1 die instead
LimitsEasy 10 · Standard 8 · Hard 6 · Absurd 4 · Legendary 2

Cost/RewardEffect
StartWIT + NERVE + 1, not counting species bonuses
1 SP+1 die to a roll · run a Silk Line (≤5 squares)
2 SPReroll up to 3 dice that missed · build a web structure · Improvise (a plausible Skill with its own Attribute, +1 Difficulty)
3 SPSilk Clutch (your own Failure → Success, Alert +1) · Damage Control (crew, any split: one spike of +2 or more −1, once/heist)
4 SPNot Part of the Plan (negate one complication, once/heist)
Earn +1Flaw bites · spectacular funny failure · creative species use
Earn +2Genuinely brilliant plan, table agrees, ST confirms

StateEffect
UnharmedFull pool.
Rattled−1 die on all rolls.
Hurt−2 dice, half Speed.
Critical−3 dice, must be assisted to move.
OutRemove from heist. Alert +2. Activate the Waiting Web.
Taking a hitDrop 1 level. Shrug off with BODY+Endurance vs the attack: beat = no drop; tie or lose by 1–2 = drop 1; lose by 3+ = drop 2. No attack pool? It rolls its Ch 15 Difficulty.

PhaseSummary
1 — The ScoreST presents the job and the visible map. Roleplay only. No rolls, no Alert.
2 — PlanningCase for intel (a Success = one true detail, never the unknown). Make Preparations (one per spider; setup, not auto-wins, except a Contingency; each gets a complication).
3 — The Heist3–4 obstacles, two successful rolls each (a group check counts as both). The Alert climbs. At least one thing the crew didn't uncover.
4 — The Escape1–2 obstacles, one successful roll each. Alert carries over. At least one must be solvable without Athletics.
5 — DebriefCount loot, award AP, argue about what happened, take the next job.

Advancement Points

ResultAP
Full SuccessEasy 2 · Standard 3 · Hard 5 · Absurd 6 · Legendary 8
PartialHalf AP, rounded down
Caught at the endOut in the last Escape obstacle: that player earns half
Loss0 AP. Never discussed.
Spending AP1 AP: +1 to a Skill · 2 AP: +1 to an Attribute · 3 AP: a new Perk from your Role list (no maximum). Skills and Attributes max 5 after creation. Unspent AP carry over.

Good luck out there. The cat is watching. Don't get vacuumed.
